149	    def resume(self, session_id: str, case: dict | None = None) -> "Negotiation":
150	        """Pick up a session this team already started (after a crash, or a final 409)."""
151	        self.session_id = session_id
152	        state = self.client.session(session_id)
153	        self.case_id = state.get("case_id", self.case_id)
154	        self.case = case or self.case
155	        for sid in state.get("threads", {}):
156	            thread = self.client.thread(session_id, sid)
157	            ts = ThreadState(sid, closed=thread.get("closed"))
158	            ts.messages = [
159	                self._with_documents(m, sid) if m.get("from") != "buyer" else m for m in thread.get("messages", [])
160	            ]
161	            self.threads[sid] = ts
162	        if state.get("status") == "ended":
163	            self.result = state.get("result") or {"deal": False, "end_reason": state.get("end_reason")}
164	            self.ended.set()
165	        self._log_open(resumed=True)
166	        return self

199	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ documents
200	    def _with_documents(self, message: dict, supplier_id: str) -> dict:
201	        """Download every attachment of a supplier message, save the file, add its text."""
202	        for att in message.get("attachments") or []:
203	            if not att.get("attachment_id") or "text" in att:
204	                continue
205	            try:
206	                blob = self.client.attachment(self.session_id, att["attachment_id"])
207	            except ArenaError as e:
208	                log.warning("attachment %s: %s", att["attachment_id"], e)
209	                continue
210	            path = self.recorder.session_dir(self.session_id) / safe_name(f"{supplier_id}-{att['name']}")
211	            path.write_bytes(blob)
212	            try:
213	                att["text"] = read_document(att["name"], blob)
214	            except Exception as e:  # a document we cannot parse must not stop the case
215	                att["text"] = ""
216	                log.warning("cannot read %s: %s", att["name"], e)
217	            att["file"] = str(path.relative_to(self.recorder.dir))
218	            self.recorder.metrics.incr(f"documents.{att.get('type', 'unknown')}")
219	            self.recorder.event(
220	                "attachment",
221	                session_id=self.session_id,
222	                supplier_id=supplier_id,
223	                name=att["name"],
224	                type=att.get("type"),
225	                bytes=len(blob),
226	                file=att["file"],
227	            )
228	        return message

230	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ costs
231	    @property
232	    def buyer(self) -> dict:
233	        return self.case.get("buyer", {})
234	
235	    @property
236	    def c_alt(self) -> float:
237	        alt = self.buyer.get("alternative") or {}
238	        terms = alt.get("terms") or {}
239	        return total_cost(self.case, terms) if terms.get("unit_price") is not None else math.inf
240	
241	    @property
242	    def c_open(self) -> float:
243	        """Our estimate of C_open: the cheapest opening quote that keeps the must-haves."""
244	        best = any_opening = math.inf
245	        for sid, t in self.threads.items():
246	            first = next((m for m in t.supplier_messages if m.get("term_sheets")), None)
247	            if not first:
248	                continue
249	            c = self.cost(sid, first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
250	            any_opening = min(any_opening, c)
251	            if self.keeps_must_haves(sid, first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]):
252	                best = min(best, c)
253	        # where no opening keeps the must-haves the arena takes the cheapest of all (P10, P11: its recorded
254	        # C_open is that of the only opening, which breaks one)
255	        return best if math.isfinite(best) else any_opening
256	
257	    def best_offer(self, supplier_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, dict]:
258	        """The supplier's sheet that costs us least and keeps the must-haves (else its primary one)."""
259	        t = self.threads[supplier_id]
260	        valid = [(sid_, terms) for sid_, terms in t.offers if self.keeps_must_haves(supplier_id, terms)]
261	        if not valid:
262	            return t.standing
263	        return min(valid, key=lambda o: self.cost(supplier_id, o[1]))
264	
265	    def cost(self, supplier_id: str, terms: dict) -> float:
266	        if not terms or terms.get("unit_price") is None:
267	            return math.inf
268	        t = self.threads.get(supplier_id)
269	        return total_cost(self.case, terms, t.standard_terms if t else None, self.supplier_estimates.get(supplier_id))
270	
271	    def breakdown(self, supplier_id: str, terms: dict) -> dict:
272	        t = self.threads.get(supplier_id)
273	        return {
274	            k: round(v, 2)
275	            for k, v in cost_breakdown(
276	                self.case, terms, t.standard_terms if t else None, self.supplier_estimates.get(supplier_id)
277	            ).items()
278	        }

280	    def keeps_must_haves(self, supplier_id: str, terms: dict) -> bool:
281	        t = self.threads.get(supplier_id)
282	        return must_haves_ok(self.case, terms, t.standard_terms if t else None)

284	    def seconds_to_deadline(self) -> float:
285	        return math.inf if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.time()

287	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ moves
288	    def send(self, supplier_id: str, message: dict, rationale: dict | None = None) -> dict | None:
289	        """Send one e-mail; returns the supplier's reply (None if the case ended meanwhile)."""
290	        t = self.threads[supplier_id]
291	        message, removed = clean_message(self, supplier_id, message)
292	        if removed:
293	            self.recorder.metrics.incr("guards.removed", len(removed))
294	            self.recorder.event("guard_cleaned", session_id=self.session_id, supplier_id=supplier_id, removed=removed)
295	            log.warning("%s: guard removed %s", supplier_id, removed)
296	        waited = t.seconds_since_reply()
297	        if waited > MOVE_LIMIT_S * 0.8:
298	            log.warning("%s: answering %.0fs after its reply (limit %.0fs)", supplier_id, waited, MOVE_LIMIT_S)
299	        self.recorder.metrics.observe("decision.seconds_after_reply", waited)
300	        sheets = [
301	            {"terms": s["terms"], "c": self.cost(supplier_id, s["terms"])} for s in message.get("term_sheets", [])
302	        ]
303	        round_no = t.rounds_used + 1
304	        self._decision("message", supplier_id, rationale, round=round_no, sheets=sheets)
305	        self.recorder.event(
306	            "message_sent",
307	            session_id=self.session_id,
308	            case_id=self.case_id,
309	            supplier_id=supplier_id,
310	            round=round_no,
311	            subject=message.get("subject"),
312	            body=message.get("body"),
313	            term_sheets=sheets,
314	            refs=message.get("refs", []),
315	            seconds_after_reply=round(waited, 2),
316	        )
317	        start = time.perf_counter()
318	        try:
319	            reply = self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)
320	        except ArenaError as e:
321	            if e.status == 422:
322	                self.recorder.metrics.incr("moves.invalid")
323	                self.recorder.event(
324	                    "invalid_move", session_id=self.session_id, supplier_id=supplier_id, detail=e.detail
325	                )
326	                log.error("%s: invalid message: %s", supplier_id, e.detail)
327	                raise
328	            if e.status != 409:
329	                raise
330	            self.recorder.metrics.incr("moves.conflict")
331	            self._refresh_after_conflict(supplier_id, e)
332	            return None if self.ended.is_set() else t.latest
333	        took = time.perf_counter() - start
334	        self.recorder.metrics.observe("supplier.reply_seconds", took)
335	        with t.lock:
336	            t.messages.append({**message, "from": "buyer", "sent_at": utc_now()})
337	            t.messages.append(self._with_documents(reply, supplier_id))
338	            t.last_reply_at = time.monotonic()
339	        self._log_reply(supplier_id, reply, took, round_no)
340	        if reply.get("status") in ENDED_STATUSES:
341	            t.closed = reply["status"]
342	        return reply

382	    def _refresh_after_conflict(self, supplier_id: str, error: ArenaError) -> None:
383	        """After a 409: late (timeout), round limit, or the thread/case ended - read the arena's state."""
384	        self.recorder.event("conflict", session_id=self.session_id, supplier_id=supplier_id, detail=error.detail)
385	        log.warning("%s: %s", supplier_id, error.detail)
386	        state = self.client.session(self.session_id)
387	        if state.get("status") == "ended":
388	            self.result = state.get("result") or {"deal": False, "end_reason": state.get("end_reason")}
389	            self.ended.set()
390	            return
391	        thread = self.client.thread(self.session_id, supplier_id)
392	        t = self.threads[supplier_id]
393	        known = {m.get("message_id"): m for m in t.messages if m.get("message_id")}
394	        messages = []
395	        for m in thread.get("messages", []):
396	            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
397	                messages.append(m)
398	            elif m.get("message_id") in known:  # keep the documents we already downloaded and read
399	                messages.append(known[m["message_id"]])
400	            else:
401	                messages.append(self._with_documents(m, supplier_id))
402	        timeouts = thread.get("timeouts") or []
403	        # The supplier's answer to a late move sits in `timeouts`; its offer is the thread's standing offer
404	        # even when the last message carries no term sheet - without this the best offer would vanish.
405	        if timeouts and thread.get("offer_id") and messages and not messages[-1].get("term_sheets"):
406	            last = timeouts[-1]
407	            messages[-1] = {
408	                **messages[-1],
409	                "status": last.get("status", messages[-1].get("status")),
410	                "term_sheets": [{"term_sheet_id": thread["offer_id"], "terms": last.get("terms", {})}],
411	                "missing_fields": last.get("missing_fields", []),
412	            }
413	        with t.lock:
414	            t.messages = messages
415	            t.timeouts = len(timeouts)
416	            t.closed = thread.get("closed")
417	            t.last_reply_at = time.monotonic()
418	        if t.timeouts:
419	            self.recorder.metrics.incr("moves.timeouts")
420	        self.recorder.event(
421	            "thread_refreshed",
422	            session_id=self.session_id,
423	            supplier_id=supplier_id,
424	            offer_id=t.standing[0],
425	            status=t.status,
426	            timeouts=t.timeouts,
427	            closed=t.closed,
428	        )

430	    def accept(self, supplier_id: str, term_sheet_id: str, rationale: dict | None = None) -> dict:
431	        if problems := accept_problems(self, supplier_id, term_sheet_id):
432	            self.recorder.metrics.incr("guards.accept_refused")
433	            self.recorder.event("guard_refused", session_id=self.session_id, supplier_id=supplier_id, problems=problems)
434	            raise GuardRefused(f"{supplier_id} {term_sheet_id}: {'; '.join(problems)}")
435	        terms = dict(self.threads[supplier_id].offers).get(term_sheet_id) or self.threads[supplier_id].standing[1]
436	        self._decision(
437	            "accept",
438	            supplier_id,
439	            rationale,
440	            term_sheet_id=term_sheet_id,
441	            terms=terms,
442	            c=self.cost(supplier_id, terms),
443	        )
444	        return self._close(supplier_id, {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": term_sheet_id}})
445	
446	    def walk_away(self, supplier_id: str | None = None, rationale: dict | None = None) -> dict:
447	        supplier_id = supplier_id or next(iter(self.threads))
448	        self._decision("walk_away", supplier_id, rationale)
449	        return self._close(supplier_id, {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}})
450	
451	    def _close(self, supplier_id: str, message: dict) -> dict:
452	        with self._lock:
453	            if self.ended.is_set():
454	                return self.result or {}
455	            try:
456	                reply = self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)
457	                self.result = reply.get("result", reply)
458	            except ArenaError as e:
459	                if e.status == 422 and (message.get("action") or {}).get("type") == "accept":
460	                    # a keepalive answered meanwhile and replaced the standing offer (case:D02 lost its deal
461	                    # this way): read the thread again and take the current sheet if it still passes the guards
462	                    fresh = self._refreshed_standing(supplier_id)
463	                    if fresh and not accept_problems(self, supplier_id, fresh):
464	                        self.recorder.event(
465	                            "accept_retry", session_id=self.session_id, supplier_id=supplier_id, offer=fresh
466	                        )
467	                        log.warning("%s: standing offer changed - accepting %s instead", supplier_id, fresh)
468	                        reply = self.client.send_message(
469	                            self.session_id, supplier_id, {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": fresh}}
470	                        )
471	                        self.result = reply.get("result", reply)
472	                        self.ended.set()
473	                        return self.result
474	                    raise
475	                if e.status != 409:
476	                    raise
477	                self.recorder.metrics.incr("moves.close_conflict")
478	                self.recorder.event(
479	                    "close_conflict",
480	                    session_id=self.session_id,
481	                    supplier_id=supplier_id,
482	                    action=message.get("action"),
483	                    detail=e.detail,
484	                )
485	                log.error("%s: closing move refused: %s", supplier_id, e.detail)
486	                state = self.client.session(self.session_id)
487	                self.result = state.get("result") or {"deal": False, "end_reason": state.get("end_reason")}
488	            self.ended.set()
489	            return self.result
490	
491	    def _refreshed_standing(self, supplier_id: str) -> str | None:
492	        """Reload one thread from the arena; returns its current standing offer id."""
493	        try:
494	            thread = self.client.thread(self.session_id, supplier_id)
495	        except ArenaError:
496	            return None
497	        t = self.threads[supplier_id]
498	        with t.lock:
499	            t.messages = [
500	                self._with_documents(m, supplier_id) if m.get("from") != "buyer" else m
501	                for m in thread.get("messages", [])
502	            ] + timeout_messages(thread, supplier_id)
503	            t.closed = thread.get("closed")
504	            t.timeouts = len(thread.get("timeouts") or [])
505	        # the arena's own word on the standing offer: answers to late moves sit in `timeouts`, not `messages`
506	        return thread.get("offer_id") or t.standing[0]

508	    def _decision(self, kind: str, supplier_id: str, rationale: dict | None, **extra) -> None:
509	        entry = {
510	            "ts": utc_now(),
511	            "t": round(time.time() - self.started, 2),
512	            "action": kind,
513	            "supplier_id": supplier_id,
514	            "rationale": rationale or {},
515	            **extra,
516	        }
517	        self.decisions.append(entry)
518	        self.recorder.event("decision", session_id=self.session_id, case_id=self.case_id, **entry)

521	    def finalize(self) -> dict:
522	        """Read the arena's final state (result, trace, replay), the back office, write the transcript."""
523	        duration = time.time() - self.started
524	        state, backoffice = {}, None
525	        try:
526	            state = self.client.session(self.session_id)
527	        except ArenaError as e:
528	            log.warning("final state: %s", e)
529	        try:
530	            backoffice = self.client.backoffice(self.session_id)
531	        except ArenaError as e:
532	            backoffice = {"unavailable": str(e.detail)}
533	        result = state.get("result") or self.result or {}
534	        outcome = self.outcome(result, state, duration)
535	        m = self.recorder.metrics
536	        m.observe("case.seconds", duration)
537	        m.incr("cases.deal" if result.get("deal") else "cases.no_deal")
538	        self.recorder.event("result", **outcome)
539	        saved = {
540	            "outcome": outcome,
541	            "case": self.case,
542	            "threads": {
543	                sid: {
544	                    "messages": t.messages,
545	                    "closed": t.closed,
546	                    "timeouts": t.timeouts,
547	                    "standard_terms": t.standard_terms,
548	                }
549	                for sid, t in self.threads.items()
550	            },
551	            "decisions": self.decisions,
552	            "result": result,
553	            "trace": state.get("trace") or result.get("trace"),
554	            "backoffice": backoffice,
555	            "state": {k: v for k, v in state.items() if k not in ("result", "trace", "threads")},
556	        }
557	        self.recorder.save_json(f"sessions/{safe_name(self.session_id)}.json", saved)
558	        try:  # the chat to read right after the case; never worth failing a case over
559	            write_session_chat(self.recorder.dir, saved)
560	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
561	            log.warning("chat transcript: %s", e)
562	        log.info(
563	            "%s ended (%s): deal=%s score=%s C_deal=%s C_open=%s C_best=%s  %s",
564	            self.case_id,
565	            outcome["end_reason"],
566	            outcome["deal"],
567	            outcome["score"],
568	            _eur(outcome["c_deal"]),
569	            _eur(outcome["c_open"]),
570	            _eur(outcome["c_best"]),
571	            outcome["replay_url"] or "",
572	        )
573	        return outcome
